# DIDADI

DIDADI applies a fixed heading color across H1 through H6 and uses orange accents matched to the vault appearance. Light and dark modes are supported through Obsidian CSS variables, and the theme is standalone, with no remote assets, external fonts or dependencies.

![DIDADI screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fyaic/DIDADI-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "DIDADI"
    author: "Rosetta Zidian Guo"
    repo:   "fyaic/DIDADI-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "didadi"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/didadi"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/fyaic/DIDADI-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fyaic/DIDADI-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a fixed DIDADI heading color across H1–H6 and use orange accents matched to the vault appearance. Support light and dark modes via Obsidian CSS variables while remaining fully standalone with no remote assets, external fonts, or dependencies."
}
```
